title: SFBond 실버폭스 #033 · 바디페인팅 · 목 링 벽 고리 + 발목 쇠공 · 체형 wide hip narrow · Latina · early 40s · 헤어 voluminous curls framing her face
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Latina woman, a warm caramel complexion, early 40s silver fox goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white voluminous curls framing her face — full body Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold formations — a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, BLAZING CARVED CREAM and VIVID GOLD bands following every deep curve of her body, dense leaf scrolls filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet. Her expression is a still, steady expression. Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin chrome nails carved cream gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
